title: 5.3 Graphing Radical Functions

icans: I can find the domain and range of a radical function.
I can describe and write transformations of radical functions.

vocab: a function with the ___________ in a radicand, like f(x) = √x or f(x) = ∛x
Domain of a square root function
g(x) = a·ⁿ√(x − h) + k: a ____________/shrinks (and reflects if a < 0), h moves left/right, k moves up/down

blocks.p: Complete each table. Then graph both functions.
Desmos. Type y = a√(x − h) + k and add sliders. What does each number do?

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Parent functions: f(x) = √x has domain _______________ and range _______________. f(x) = ∛x has domain _______________ and range _______________.

blocks.stem: Graph f(x) = √(x + 3). Identify the domain and range.

notes: Transformations: a: In g(x) = a·ⁿ√(x − h) + k: a stretches or shrinks the graph, and a < 0 _______________ it in the x-axis.

blocks.stem: Graph g(x) = −2∛x. Identify the domain and range.

notes: Transformations: h and k: h translates the graph _______________ (h > 0) or _______________ (h < 0). k translates it _______________ (k > 0) or _______________ (k < 0).
